answer_1.quote: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the development of automated coding agents capable of generating code for software engineering tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code patches and test cases

answer_2.quote: the benchmark evaluates performance by measuring the percentage of patches that successfully pass both types of tests for each instance.

answer_4.quote: When UTBoost detects discrepancies between the gold patch and generated patches under augmented test cases, two authors with four years of software testing experience manually review the test cases and patches, reaching a consensus on whether the issue stems from inadequate test coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Review test cases and patches to determine if inadequate test coverage is the cause of discrepancy
